heading: Distribution of damages
lead: Monetary relief recovered in an action under section 15c(a)(1) of this title shall— subject in either case to the requirement that any distribution procedure adopted afford each person a reasonable opportunity to secure his appropriate portion of the net monetary relief.

tree.text: be distributed in such manner as the district court in its discretion may authorize; or
be deemed a civil penalty by the court and deposited with the State as general revenues;

notes.text: Effective DateInjuries sustained prior to Sept. 30, 1976, not covered by this section, see section 304 of Pub. L. 94–435, set out as a note under section 15c of this title.
